aspect: Prevalence in exposed child populations is not marginal
description: 57.8% of displaced Gazan children screened positive for PTSD on CATS cutoffs, 15.6% meeting the stricter DSM-5 algorithm; pooled estimates from earlier Palestinian child studies put it at 36%, and Syrian refugee children at 30-50%. After the November 2012 war, 53.5% of 1,029 pupils aged 11-17 met DSM-V criteria.
energy_note: A majority of a generation, not an unlucky minority.
source_name: Child Adolesc Psychiatry Ment Health 2026; PMC7137754

aspect: Avoidance is the part that wrecks the life
description: Not the nightmares. The systematic, invisible narrowing of where the person will go, what they will watch, who they will talk to and what subjects are permitted - each avoidance individually reasonable, collectively a cage.
energy_note: A life that gets smaller by one room a year.

description: Intrusive material consumes working memory. The result looks like someone who cannot follow a meeting or finish a document, and is appraised as such by managers who have no idea.
money_note: Lost earnings and promotions over a career.
energy_note: Demoted for an injury nobody can see.

aspect: Irritability costs the relationships that would have helped
description: The anger is disproportionate, the person knows it is disproportionate, and knowing does not prevent it. The people who leave because of it are usually the ones who were the support.
energy_note: Driving off the people who were holding you up.

aspect: Complex PTSD is common where the exposure was prolonged
description: Recent Gaza research reports alarmingly high rates of both PTSD and complex PTSD, with emotional regulation, identity and relational functioning affected rather than just fear responses.
energy_note: Not a fear problem. A self problem.

aspect: SECONDARY - the cost is paid over forty years, in instalments
description: Reduced earnings, earlier exit from work, higher medical utilisation, more relationship breakdowns. None of it is invoiced to the war.
energy_note: A bill that arrives monthly for four decades.
